record.question: What is the standard CT protocol for a patient presenting with symptoms consistent with a pulmonary embolism (PE)?
options: CT angiogram of the pulmonary arteries (CTPA).
CT chest with oral contrast only.
record.explanation: Answer B: CT angiogram of the pulmonary arteries (CTPA).. CT pulmonary angiography is the standard CT protocol for suspected pulmonary embolism when appropriate. Reference: https://www.radiologyinfo.org/en/info/bodyct; https://www.acr.org/Clinical-Resources/Clinical-Tools-and-Reference/Contrast-Manual. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
